model.description: Anthropic model id (e.g. claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022, claude-3-haiku-20240307, claude-opus-4-5). Left blank until live discovery selects the cheapest available model.

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort level (model-specific). Common values: disabled, low, medium, high, xhigh

batchMode.description: Batch by target language or by entry

useStructuredOutput.description: No effect for Claude: Anthropic has no JSON-schema response_format compatible with this module's text-parsing flow (its tool-shim path returns a tool call, not text), so this flag is currently a no-op. Kept for config parity with the other LLM providers.
